task: Fix the Assistants list so a pinned assistant stays pinned after page refresh by correcting the ordering between preferences load and fetch-time is_pinned derivation (frontend only).

key_reasoning.reason: Not an L, but spans assistantsStore (indexAssistants, normalizeAssistant), favoritesStore, preferencesStore and possibly the useInitialDataFetch/App bootstrap or AssistantCard, all within the frontend store/hook layers with a clear existing derivation pattern.

Symptom is clear, but the root cause is a code-evidenced race that has not been reproduced, and the fix approach is an open design decision (gate on preferences, render-time derivation, or re-map on load), plus whether Favorites and normalizeAssistant are in scope. Calibrated against the S example epmcdme-10102 (total 11), which has no open design decision.

Closest pattern is the existing fetch-time is_pinned derivation and updateAssistantsWithLikedStatus post-fetch patch, but neither covers async ordering against preferences. No security surface. Moderate regression risk for the sidebar and PinnedAssistantsEditPopup, which share the preferences snapshot; tests mock preferencesStore as a static null, so a reactive fix needs new test scaffolding.
Roughly 3-4 source files plus 2-3 test files, mostly under src/store and src/pages/assistants.
